scope: AASM 2019 PAP guideline. The PMC XML has no article body; the abstract contains the recommendation statements used here.

keyRecommendations.text: Use PAP rather than no therapy for OSA with excessive sleepiness (strong).
keyRecommendations.population: Adults with OSA and excessive sleepiness

keyRecommendations.text: Start PAP with home APAP or in-laboratory titration when there are no significant comorbidities (strong). Continue with CPAP or APAP (strong).
keyRecommendations.population: Adults with OSA without significant comorbidities

keyRecommendations.text: Educational interventions at initiation are a strong recommendation. PAP for impaired sleep-related quality of life or comorbid hypertension is conditional.

clinicalBottomLine: Offer PAP to adults with OSA and sleepiness, start with home APAP or a lab titration if there are no major comorbidities, and give education when treatment starts.
notableCaveats: Recommendation labels are those printed in the abstract. The full evidence profiles are not in the XML.

source.title: Treatment of adult obstructive sleep apnea with positive airway pressure: an American Academy of Sleep Medicine clinical practice guideline.
